answer: Correlation-discounted matching: when agents pool tips to fund a project, the network adds a square-root bonus, but it shrinks the bonus for donors who always back the same things together. A sybil ring that props up its own haven project like vines on one trellis is easy to spot, because its donors move in lockstep, so its bonus fades toward zero. To win real matching, each fake must build a distinct, believable giving history, a costly violet-ink paper trail per identity.
